My review confirms the feature set. The implementation is a minimal single-user bookmark manager: save/edit-in-place with duplicate convergence, metadata title/description fetch (description discarded), tags, tag-chip filtering, case-insensitive substring search, read-later view, archive view. No delete, no bulk actions, no sort control, no `#tag`/boolean/phrase search syntax, no tag autocomplete, no markdown rendering, no snapshots, no bundles, no import/export, no settings.
